data: What is the approximate value of the blue line at β = 0.5 in the first plot?

The question asks for the approximate value of the blue line at β = 0.5 in the first plot. The first plot corresponds to Figure 2(a), which shows the trade-off curve of G-BLEU and Style accuracy according to α (at β = 0.5) in Yelp. The blue line represents G-BLEU. By examining the graph, the blue line appears to be around 20.5 at β = 0.5. Therefore, the approximate value of the blue line at β = 0.5 in the first plot is 20.5.
